state_machine.description: Conservative initial state; after input sampling, indicates an active E-stop. Startup inhibition runs independently.
E-stop is inactive. Gap monitoring is permitted only after startup inhibition expires.

timer_plan.name: T_Startup
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Fresh instance or power-up reinitialization only; E-stop does not reset it.
timer_plan.semantics: Starts with elapsed time zero on the first FB invocation. Q becomes TRUE at elapsed time >= 5 seconds and remains TRUE. Time advances monotonically through E-stop.

timer_plan.name: T_Gap
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Reset on any invocation where startup is active, E-stop is active, or Gap_Exceeded is FALSE.
timer_plan.semantics: The first eligible sampled invocation has elapsed time zero, including the scan that completes startup. Q becomes TRUE after a continuous eligible interval of at least DebounceTime. DebounceTime is assumed positive and constant within a test.

priorities: E-stop immediately suppresses Operator_Alert and clears gap timing; it does not interrupt or restart startup timing.
Startup inhibition suppresses Operator_Alert and prevents gap timing. Weld_Soft_Start_Active reports startup independently of E-stop.
A FALSE gap input immediately suppresses the alert and clears gap timing.
Only a continuously qualified gap after startup with E-stop inactive permits the alert.

initial_values.note: Elapsed values are timer state, not separate accumulating counters. These values apply to a fresh instance before its first invocation.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample all inputs once. Timer enable transitions are determined from these sampled values; no unobserved input stability is assumed.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Set state to E_STOP when sampled Weld_E_Stop_NC is FALSE, otherwise READY. Establish gap suppression for active E-stop or FALSE gap; startup suppression is resolved using the current startup timer result in stage 3.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls
scan_execution_order.actions: Outside all CASE/IF branches, call T_Startup(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5s), then call T_Gap(IN := T_Startup.Q AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND Gap_Exceeded, PT := DebounceTime). The second call uses the current-scan T_Startup.Q, so the startup-expiry scan is the first eligible gap sample.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Assign Weld_Soft_Start_Active := NOT T_Startup.Q. Assign Operator_Alert := T_Startup.Q AND Weld_E_Stop_NC AND Gap_Exceeded AND T_Gap.Q, using current-scan timer results and sampled inputs.
